name: Ashutosh Pratap Singh
detail: Ashutosh Pratap Singh is the co-founder of Peelz Factory and a progressive farmer from Gawan, Sambhal, Uttar Pradesh. A former corporate regional manager who left a 17-year career in 2018, he transformed his ancestral land into a model of sustainable, organic agriculture. His innovations include a 65-bed vermicompost unit, multi-crop sugarcane models, Thai Super Napier fodder, and value-added products like organic jaggery in 12 flavors, ganna masala chutney, and sugarcane ice cream. He met President Droupadi Murmu on January 26 at Rashtrapati Bhavan on Republic Day, a proud moment honoring his contributions. For over seven years, he has conducted R&D in bioenzyme production, creating viable, useful products for people. Through the Buland Farmers Development Trust, he trains farmers and women's self-help groups, and collaborates with Namami Gange and HDFC Bank.

name: Taru Singh
detail: Taru Singh is the Co-founder and Director of Peelz Factory Pvt. Ltd. and a progressive farmer, social leader, and rural entrepreneur from Gawan, Block Rajpura, District Sambhal, Uttar Pradesh. With strong academic credentials in Zoology, Food Processing, and Organic Farming, combined with over 7 years of hands-on experience, she has pioneered the conversion of kitchen and farm waste into eco-friendly bio-enzymes that support chemical-free agriculture, animal hygiene, and home-care solutions. Her innovations include a Bio-enzyme Animal Tick Cleaner selected by IVRI under RKVY – Startup India, and a Soil & Plant Bio-Tonic selected for incubation at IARI PUSA – Shitij Program. She is a Certified Master Trainer in Agricultural Bio-Enzymes and has spoken at national and international programs with participants from Nepal, Nairobi, Dubai, Thailand, Malaysia, and Sri Lanka. She serves as Secretary of the Bio Enzyme Entrepreneurs Academy (BEA) and State President of WICCI, Uttar Pradesh.

name: Surendra Pal Singh
detail: Surendra Pal Singh is a distinguished veterinary professional with a BVSc from Mathura and a long, respected career in public service as Joint Director with the Uttarakhand government. Having spent decades working at the intersection of animal health and rural development, he brings deep scientific knowledge and administrative wisdom to Peelz Factory. As an advisor, he guides the team on animal care, product credibility, and responsible growth, helping turn grassroots innovation into trusted solutions for farmers and livestock keepers.

name: Chhavi Singh
detail: Chhavi Singh is an M.Sc. Gold Medalist in Horticulture from Rajasthan Agriculture University, Bikaner, whose academic excellence is matched by her commitment to the field. She works closely with the NGO to promote sustainable agricultural practices, bridging modern horticultural science with the everyday needs of farmers. Her expertise strengthens Peelz Factory's mission of healthier soil, better crops, and chemical-free farming for future generations.

name: Tulika Singh
detail: Tulika Singh is a retired Wing Commander who served the nation for 14 years in the Indian Air Force, followed by 2 years in the corporate world at Airtel. Her journey from disciplined military service to the private sector gives her a rare blend of strategic vision, operational discipline, and people-first leadership. As an advisor, she brings strong leadership and management expertise that helps Peelz Factory plan boldly, execute with precision, and grow with purpose.
